attempts.summary: Built the transit/lan-a/lan-b topology (VyOS node1, OPNsense node2, RHEL7 node3/node4), routed node3→node4 tcp/23 through node1 then node2, configured node1 to accept+log the flow and node2 to reject+log it, demonstrated one connection attempt producing a correlated accept/block log pair (matched by IP ID and 5-tuple) proving traffic passed node1 and stopped at node2, then restarted all four nodes one at a time with proof of changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery, re-verified with a second attempt after restarts.
